title: Mercure’s Signature Dish Writeup

steps.text: Story: Hotel Me.Mercure is an online secret food ordering platform. Find a way to order their signature dishes!

Solution: A URL is provided, which leads to a login page. The challenger has to login using username and password, but as we know the password is not given (username is provided).
 After logging in, you can find a PDF file, which is also protected by a password. Inside the PDF, the flag is hidden. You have to find out the password to login and also you have to crack the password of the pdf file.

steps.source_heading: 3. Use “John the Ripper” to crack the password for this file, and the flag will be hidden in the PDF. A simple text hiding method was used to hide the flag.
